description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the `neo-market` CLI workflow. 2. Agent runs `neo-market register --manifest ipfs://Qm<anything>` — the manifest MUST use the `ipfs://` URI prefix or registration fails. 3. Agent runs `neo-market jobs --limit 5` and reads the output to identify that only Job #2 ('On-Chain Data Analysis') has Status: Open. Jobs #1 (Assigned), #3 (Completed), #4 (Cancelled), #5 (Expired) must be ignored — distractor files suggest wrong job IDs (5) and wrong escrow IDs (3, 22). 4. Agent runs `neo-market bid --job 2 --price 380 --eta 7200 --cid ipfs://QmProposalXYZ789abc`. The critical proprietary trap: `--eta` is in SECONDS (7200), not hours (2). Distractor files use 'eta_hours' to mislead. The `--cid` must use the `ipfs://` prefix — distractor files show bare CIDs without it. 5. Agent reads the bid confirmation output which states 'Escrow ID: 7'. This is the only way to obtain the correct escrow ID — distractor files show escrow 3 and 22 as red herrings. 6. Agent runs `neo-market deliver --job 2 --escrow 7 --cid ipfs://QmResultABC123def`. Wrong escrow ID causes explicit failure. 7. Final state: Job #2 is Completed, all workflow steps logged in correct order.
